methodHandling.otherMethods: Any non-POST -> 405 {"error":"Method not allowed"}, checked BEFORE auth.

auth.notes: After method check, before body parse.

request.parse: await req.json() uncaught: malformed/empty -> 500 'Internal error'; JSON null -> TypeError -> 500; non-object -> fields undefined -> 400 'Missing params'.

fields.name: jobIds
fields.bounds: Array.isArray && length > 0; element types/count NOT validated, not checked against the deck or user

fields.name: presentationTitle
fields.validation: none (a non-string would be rejected upstream -> 502)

bodyShape.deckJobId: string = upstream deck_id (key omitted if upstream had none)

errors.when: deckId falsy, jobIds not an array, or empty
upstream non-2xx (no 413/422 passthrough here, unlike pptx-submit)
malformed JSON, null body, non-UUID deckId, missing env, network error, upstream 2xx non-JSON

sideEffects: void incrementExportCounts(userId, deckId) on success - counts a deck export in addition to each per-slide pptx-submit count.
externalCalls: POST ${PPTX_API_URL}/decks, headers Authorization: Bearer ${PPTX_API_TOKEN}, Content-Type: application/json, body {job_ids: jobIds, presentation_title: presentationTitle ?? ''} (pptx-deck-submit.ts:20-24). Upstream (slidestudio compat routes.py:176-189) returns 202 {deck_id, status:'queued', poll_url}; 422 if job_ids empty/not strings.
quirks: jobIds are not checked to belong to deckId or the caller - any job ids are stitched.
deckId is only used for the ownership check and export counter; it is not sent upstream.
beforeAnyState: Deck missing -> 403. Unknown jobIds: upstream accepts and the stitch later fails (status 'failed').

callers.expects: body {deckId, jobIds, presentationTitle? (only when title query present)}; any >=400 -> 'PPTX stitch failed (<status>)'; 2xx must have non-empty deckJobId

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:1077-1113 - matches 200 {deckJobId}; no error responses documented.

planSection65: Row '/api/pptx-deck-submit (POST) | {deckId, jobIds[], presentationTitle} -> {deckJobId}' - accurate; add status 200, 405-before-auth, 400 'Missing params', 403, 502 'PPTX service error'.
